Big update for both the phone and the watch. **Install both files.**

**Before installing:** the phone app now has its own app ID (needed for Google Play), so Android sees it as a new app. Uninstall the old Notification Sync first, then install this one and grant its permissions again. Your settings start fresh.

**Watch**
- The list opens faster and fills in from the top with live notifications only, with no stale entries swapping out.
- Notifications are grouped like the phone (Conversations, Notifications, Silent) with headers you can open and close. Silent starts closed, and on Android 16 its Suggested, Promotions, News and Social categories can each be turned off.
- Several notifications from one app fold into a stack you can open, with a line down the side to tie them together.
- Smooth, bouncy open/close animations, smoother scrolling, and a Dark mode option.

**Phone**
- Settings reorganized into cards with shorter names and clearer descriptions.
- Tools has test notifications (chats, photos, email, stacks and more, with working buttons and a delay so you can lock your phone first).
- More reliable actions and buzzing: notifications removed while the app was restarting no longer get stuck on the watch without actions, and the watch app no longer pops up over other watch apps in a loop.
- Privacy policy and a clear notice before asking for notification access. The app has no internet access.
